daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Cancer. Trust those gut feelings about people and situations—they're basically your superpower right now. Channel that emotional intelligence into something creative.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether you're coupled up or single, vulnerability is your love language today. Let your walls down just a little—it creates real connection.
daily.career: Your ideas have serious potential right now, even if they feel half-baked. Pitch that thing you've been sitting on. Your colleagues are more receptive than usual to your unique perspective.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Hydrate more than feels necessary, move slowly, and honor what rest actually means to you. Your nervous system will thank you for the self-care.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to soften your edges, Cancer. You're carrying old patterns like luggage—it's time to set some down. Trust that vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower.
weekly.love: Someone's seeing you differently lately, and honestly, they might be onto something. If you're single, a genuine conversation is brewing. If coupled, reconnect over something that made you laugh together.
weekly.career: Your ideas have more weight than you think right now. Speak up in that meeting or share your vision with someone who matters. The energy supports bold honesty over playing it safe.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Whether that's stretching, longer showers, or just sleeping in—listen. Energy is tied to how you treat yourself, and you deserve that care.
